_readme: Named exceptions for scripts/i18n-scan.ts. Every entry carries a reason; the scan refuses to load one that does not, and reports an entry nothing matches any more so the file cannot silently rot.

identicalValues: a non-English value that is byte-identical to English on purpose. Two kinds qualify — a brand, product or technical token that is the same everywhere, and a word that a language genuinely spells the way English does. The first kind uses locales "*"; the second names the locales, so a regression in a locale that DOES translate it still reports.

literals: an English string in src/components or src/app that reaches the screen without t()/tr() on purpose. Adding one here is a claim that nobody will ever read it in another language — hold it to that.
